summary: Backend-only validation of iter98a admin premium dashboard endpoints: new KPI fields on /api/admin/dashboard, /api/admin/recent-sessions feed, and /api/admin/payments/csv-export with period filters + alphabetical-by-trainer sort. All 6 existing iter98 guards pass. Added 12 supplementary guards in test_iteration99_csv_export_extras.py (header columns, Content-Disposition attachment filename per period, case-insensitive sort via csv.reader, invalid date 400s, unauth 401/403, commission math, recent-sessions default limit). Full regression across iter96/97/97c/97d/98 + admin_panel_v2 = 88 passed, 3 skipped, 0 failed.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_routes.py is now 1534 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Should be split into logical modules (dashboard, verifications, payouts, refunds, messaging) before it grows further.

get_admin_dashboard makes 6 sequential DB calls (count_documents x4, find x2, list_collection_names, find on corporate_companies). Acceptable for a low-traffic admin endpoint but consider asyncio.gather for parallelism.
list_collection_names() is called on every dashboard hit; safe but unnecessary — the .find on a non-existent collection in Motor simply returns empty, so the guard could be dropped.
CSV export loads ALL completed sessions into memory (find().to_list(None)). Fine today; for scale, switch to a streaming cursor that writes rows to the StreamingResponse iterator.
Commission % calculation: when commission_base is 0 the column emits '0%' (string). Consider blank/'-' for visual clarity in spreadsheets but not a functional bug.

end_date+1 day exclusivity is correct (uses '$lt'), but if the caller also supplies a time-bearing ISO string it raises ValueError — only YYYY-MM-DD is supported. Worth documenting in the endpoint docstring.
seed_data_creation: None; tests use only the read-only admin endpoints. No test data was inserted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rate limit on /api/auth/login is 60/min/IP. When running the full regression back-to-back, insert ~60s sleeps between suites or the admin_token fixture will fail with 429. The new file test_iteration99_csv_export_extras.py is the canonical guard for the CSV export contract (header columns, sort, filename, error codes) and should be added to any future regression batch.
rca of the issue: n/a — no defects found. iter98a feature works as designed: dashboard returns all 9 new KPI fields, recent-sessions enriches with names, CSV export sorts by lower(trainer_name) then session_date, filename suffix reflects period (this_month/last_month/all_time/all), invalid dates raise 400, and unauthenticated requests return 401/403.
